scientific_integrity: An exact characteristic-independent proof of the class-size formula accompanies the reproducible finite-field checker. Previously known centralizer methods, algebra-group constructions and graphical-group results are credited; novelty is not asserted as independently established.
scientific_limitations: The full conjugacy-class distribution is established only for the four-vertex oriented cycle, while an odd-power witness is established for every other cycle length at least three. The finite-field replay covers the prime fields of sizes 2, 3 and 5. A 1998 paper of Robinson on algebra-group class numbers was not accessible in full, leaving a literature-overlap risk. Independent mathematical validation has not been conducted.
title: Conjugacy-class sizes and a sharp parity island for fourth-truncated cyclic quiver algebra groups
